# Syed Shahmikh Ali

> Syed Shahmikh Ali is a computer science, AI and IT tutor and career mentor based in Pakistan. He teaches live one-to-one lessons online to students in the US, UK, Europe and the Gulf. He has taught 5,000+ hours since 2020, is a Preply Super Tutor, and is in the top 10% of computer science tutors on Preply. His background is Mechatronics Engineering (Air University) and cloud engineering.

## What he teaches
- AP Computer Science Principles and AP Computer Science A
- IB Computer Science (HL and SL)
- IGCSE and GCSE Computer Science
- CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701) and Cisco CCNA (200-301)
- Python, Java and object-oriented programming
- Using AI tools to study effectively, plus study strategy and career guidance

## How sessions work
- Live, one-to-one, video-based, usually 60 or 90 minutes
- Booking: [Book a free intro call](https://shahmikh.com/contact#booking)
- Grades and job outcomes are not guaranteed

## Blog posts (exam guides and study advice)
- [AP CSA ArrayList vs Array: Which to Use and FRQ 3](https://shahmikh.com/blog-ap-csa-arraylist-vs-array): Arrays have a fixed length and an ArrayList can grow and shrink. Here is how to choose, plus a safe pattern for AP CSA free-response Question 3.
- [IGCSE Computer Science Paper 1: How to Revise It](https://shahmikh.com/blog-igcse-computer-science-paper-1): Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science Paper 1 is 75 marks in 1 hour 45 minutes across six topics. Here is how to sort them and revise each type of question.
- [AP CSP Multiple Choice: Question Types and How to Practise](https://shahmikh.com/blog-ap-csp-multiple-choice): The AP CSP multiple-choice section is 70% of your score: 70 questions in 2 hours. Here are the question types, the topic weights and a practice routine.
- [AP CSA Recursion and 2D Arrays: Where the Marks Go](https://shahmikh.com/blog-ap-csa-recursion-2d-arrays): Recursion is tested only in AP CSA multiple choice, while 2D arrays have their own free-response question. Here is how to trace one and write the other.
- [SOC Analyst or Cloud Security Engineer: Which First?](https://shahmikh.com/blog-soc-analyst-vs-cloud-security-engineer): Most people should start as a SOC analyst, then move to cloud security. See what each job does, what the certs expect and a 3-question way to choose.
- [Network+ vs Security+ vs CCNA: Which to Take First?](https://shahmikh.com/blog-network-plus-vs-security-plus-vs-ccna): Network+ first if you are new to IT, then Security+ or CCNA depending on the job you want. See the exam facts side by side and a four-question way to pick.
- [Is Your Teen Struggling With the Subject or Study Habits?](https://shahmikh.com/blog-subject-or-study-habits): A parent's guide to telling a content gap from a study-habits problem in computer science, with a simple two-week check and what to do about each.
- [Security+ SY0-701: What It Covers and an 8-Week Plan](https://shahmikh.com/blog-security-plus-sy0-701-study-plan): Security+ SY0-701 has 5 domains, up to 90 questions and a 750 pass mark. See what each domain weighs and an 8-week study plan that follows those weights.
- [Python or Java as a First Language for a School Student](https://shahmikh.com/blog-python-or-java-first-language): Python or Java first? My answer depends on the exam: AP CSA needs Java, AP CSP and IGCSE do not. A clear recommendation by course, with the official rules.
- [How to Use Past Papers for Computer Science Revision](https://shahmikh.com/blog-past-papers-method): Doing past papers is not the same as learning from them. A four-step method for computer science exams: attempt, mark with the mark scheme, log errors, redo.
- [Java OOP: Classes, Inheritance and Polymorphism Explained](https://shahmikh.com/blog-java-oop-classes-inheritance-polymorphism): Learn Java classes, inheritance and polymorphism with one worked Shape example you can run, plus the three mistakes that trip up students most often.
- [IGCSE Computer Science 0478 Paper 2: How to Revise It](https://shahmikh.com/blog-igcse-computer-science-paper-2): Paper 2 is half of your IGCSE Computer Science grade. What it covers, how pseudocode is marked, how to handle the 15-mark scenario, and a revision plan.
- [CCNA 200-301: What Is on the Exam and How to Practise](https://shahmikh.com/blog-ccna-200-301-exam-guide): CCNA 200-301 v1.1 is a 120-minute exam with six domains, and Cisco says its last test day is 2 February 2027. See the topics, the weights and a lab routine.
- [AP CSP Create Task: How the Written Responses Score](https://shahmikh.com/blog-ap-csp-create-task): The AP CSP Create task is 30% of your score. See how the four written prompts are scored, the mistakes graders report, and how to design your program for them.
